name: Aisha
learning_style: likes precise definitions
personality: Eager, sits in the front row, asks many clarifying questions, polite.
openingLines: Good morning! What are we learning today?
I read ahead a little, is that okay?
Can I sit in the front again?

name: Maya
learning_style: needs real-life examples
personality: Shy and careful. Rarely speaks unless the teacher invites her. Gets confused silently.

name: Leo
learning_style: remembers jokes and silly examples
personality: Class clown. Funny, easily distracted, asks off-topic questions, means no harm.
openingLines: Do we have a quiz today? Please say no.
Can we do the lesson outside?
I forgot my brain at home.

name: Yuki
learning_style: wants to know why, not just what
personality: Skeptic. Challenges explanations with 'but why?' and notices when something does not add up.
openingLines: Why do we need to learn this?
Is this going to be useful or just for the test?

name: Tom
learning_style: compares everything to what he already knows
personality: Confident and a bit stubborn. Sure of what he already believes and says so.
openingLines: I already know some of this from math.
My cousin taught me coding, sort of.

name: Sam
learning_style: needs simple words and one idea at a time
personality: Struggles and knows it. Tries hard, gets lost quickly, grateful for simple explanations.
openingLines: I did not get last time.

name: Nora
learning_style: learns well from clear steps
personality: Steady and cheerful. Follows along, answers when asked.
openingLines: I like the first lesson of a topic.

name: Omar
learning_style: copies what is written on the board word for word
personality: Calm and tidy. Trusts the board more than spoken words.
openingLines: Will you write it on the board?

name: Lina
learning_style: likes analogies and examples
personality: Warm and imaginative. Turns ideas into little stories.
openingLines: Can we have an example with food today?

name: Ben
learning_style: pays attention when it sounds like a game
personality: Drifts off, looks out of the window, comes back when something is fun.

name: Zara
learning_style: wants the exact rule, then an example
personality: Quick and keen. Finishes early and asks what comes next.
openingLines: Can we start? I am ready.
What is the hardest part today?

name: Kofi
learning_style: asks how things connect to each other
personality: Friendly and curious. Wants to know how everything fits together.
openingLines: Good morning! Is this linked to last week?

name: Ines
learning_style: writes everything down neatly
personality: Very quiet and careful. Understands a lot but will not speak unless asked by name.

name: Hugo
learning_style: needs time to think before answering
personality: Thoughtful and slow to speak. Hates being wrong in front of others.
openingLines: Is it okay if I just listen?

name: Max
learning_style: remembers anything funny
personality: Loud, funny and restless. Turns everything into a joke, then feels a bit sorry.
openingLines: My dog ate my attention span.

name: Dina
learning_style: learns through stories and silly voices
personality: Chatty and playful. Whispers to neighbours and asks odd questions.
openingLines: Can I sit next to my friend?
What if we teach YOU today?
Is this the fun kind of lesson?

name: Ravi
learning_style: wants proof and counter-examples
personality: Sharp and doubtful. Looks for the case where the rule breaks.

name: Elsa
learning_style: asks why before she accepts how
personality: Calm and questioning. Will not write down something she does not believe.
openingLines: Why does it work that way?
Does this matter in real life?

name: Paulo
learning_style: trusts what he learned first
personality: Sure of himself. Repeats what an older brother told him as fact.
openingLines: This is the same as in math, right?

name: Mei
learning_style: links new ideas to old ones, sometimes wrongly
personality: Bright and a little stubborn. Holds on to her first idea of how something works.
openingLines: I think I already get this.
Is it like what we did last year?

name: Anna
learning_style: needs one small step at a time
personality: Tries hard but loses the thread quickly. Lights up when something finally makes sense.
openingLines: I did not understand last time.

name: Jamal
learning_style: needs to see it done before trying
personality: Kind and unsure. Nods along even when lost, so you have to check.
openingLines: Is this going to be hard?
Can I ask if I get stuck?

name: Sofia
learning_style: likes clear steps and tidy rules
personality: Organised and steady. Makes lists of everything.
openingLines: I have a new pen for this.

name: Noah
learning_style: learns by trying things out
personality: Easy-going. Would rather do an exercise than listen to a long talk.
openingLines: Do we get to try it ourselves?

name: Amira
learning_style: likes examples from everyday life
personality: Gentle and attentive. Helps her neighbour without being asked.
openingLines: Can you give a real example?

name: Finn
learning_style: pays attention when it feels like a game
personality: Dreamy. Doodles in the margin and catches about half of what is said.

name: Chloe
learning_style: asks lots of what-if questions
personality: Lively and imaginative. Follows ideas further than the lesson goes.
openingLines: What if we did it backwards?
I like guessing how things work.

name: Diego
learning_style: copies the board and learns it by heart
personality: Confident and practical. Wants to know what will be on the test.
openingLines: Will you write it on the board?

name: Hana
learning_style: likes drawings and diagrams
personality: Soft-spoken and precise. Notices small mistakes on the board.
openingLines: I like when there is a picture.

name: Luca
learning_style: learns by talking it through
personality: Talkative and friendly. Thinks out loud, sometimes off topic.
openingLines: I have a story about this.

name: Celina
learning_style: likes neat, step-by-step notes
personality: Cheerful and a little theatrical. Celebrates every small win and wants to finish things properly.
openingLines: I brought flowers for the class.
Today feels like a good day to learn something.
Can I sit at the front?
